info.title: Statamic App API
info.description:
JSON for single-page apps on Statamic, over Laravel Sanctum.

Session: fetch `/sanctum/csrf-cookie` once, then send the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie back as `X-XSRF-TOKEN` with every write (axios does this with `withCredentials: true`). Tokens: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Every error has the shape `{error: {code, message, field?, details?}}`. `code` is stable.

get.summary: What this API offers: active areas, the team header, the CSRF cookie path.
This description, as OpenAPI 3.1.

post.summary: Sign in with Statamic's login. Answers two_factor: true when a code is needed next, and two_factor_setup_required: true when the user must set up two-factor authentication before anything else.
Second step of a login with two-factor authentication: a code from the app or a recovery code.
Start setting up two-factor authentication through Statamic: the secret, a QR code (SVG) and where to confirm.
Confirm the setup with a code from the app. Answers the recovery codes.

get.summary: The current recovery codes.

post.summary: New recovery codes; the old ones stop working.

get.summary: WebAuthn assertion options for a passkey login.

post.summary: Sign in with a passkey (the WebAuthn assertion).
Create an account through Statamic's registration and sign in. Fields of the user blueprint are accepted as well.
Sign out and end the session.

get.summary: The signed-in user.

post.summary: Mail a reset link through Statamic's password broker. Always the same answer, whether the address exists or not.
Set a new password with the token from the mail.

get.summary: State of Statamic's elevated session and how this user confirms.

post.summary: Confirm with the password, the mailed code or a passkey assertion. Opens the elevated session.
Mail a confirmation code (accounts without a password).

get.summary: WebAuthn assertion options to confirm with a passkey.
Address confirmation, pending change of address, scheduled deletion and its blockers.

post.summary: Send the confirmation mail again.
Ask to change the address; the new one confirms by mail.

delete.summary: Withdraw a pending change of address.

post.summary: Schedule the deletion of the account after the grace period.
Build the personal data export and answer with a short-lived download link.

get.summary: Download a built export (signed link from POST account/export, same user only).
The user's teams with their role, and which one is current.

post.summary: Create a team; the user becomes its owner and it becomes current.

get.summary: The team of this request: the one in the team header, else the current one.

put.summary: Make a team the current one.

post.summary: Join a team with its join code.

get.summary: What an invitation is for, before accepting it.

post.summary: Accept an invitation; the team becomes current.

get.summary: One team, with the role and permissions of the user in it.
The members of a team.

put.summary: Change the role of a member.

post.summary: Leave a team.

get.summary: Pending invitations of a team.

post.summary: Invite somebody by address; the mail goes out with the link.
Issue a new join code; the old one stops working.

get.summary: Products and quotas of the user, and of the current team.
Whether the user (personally or through a team) and the current team may use a product.
One quota: limit, used, remaining, period, for the user and the current team.
What the order form must show before the order button: the consent text (for digital content the waiver of the right of withdrawal, otherwise none), its version, and the button label.

post.summary: Start a purchase and answer with the provider URL to send the buyer to. The same request twice answers with the same checkout.
post.description: The order form (§ 312j BGB): the button that sends this request must be labelled "zahlungspflichtig bestellen" (or an equally unambiguous wording), the consent text from GET checkout/terms must stand next to a checkbox the buyer ticks, `confirmed` is that checkbox, and `consent_version` the version the form showed. A different version is 409 consent_changed with the current wording in details.

get.summary: The state of a checkout this user started (after the return from the provider).

post.summary: A short-lived link into the customer portal of statamic-payments for the confirmed address of the user.

get.summary: Orders (paid) and agreements of the user, and of the current team where the user holds `view billing`, with the portal's texts, the links to the statutory cancellation and withdrawal, and the display time zone and form of address of statamic-payments.
One order with its lines and documents.
Invoices and credit notes of the visible orders (statamic-invoices), newest first.
The document as PDF (attachment, not cached).
Agreements: status, paid until, next charge, price, rhythm, masked payment method, and which actions are open.
One agreement.
What the confirmation page shows before the button (§ 312k BGB): contract, price, start, paid until, the effect, the button label.

post.summary: Cancel with effect at the end of the paid period, through statamic-payments: the provider first, then the confirmation mail. Needs `confirmed: true`, no elevated session.
post.description: The button that sends this request carries the label from GET …/cancel (`confirmation.button_label`, „Jetzt kündigen"). The answer carries the moment of the cancellation and whether the confirmation in Textform went out (`mail_sent`); show both. A second request for an agreement already ended answers the same confirmation with `already: true` and sends no second mail.

get.summary: Whether and how the agreement can be paused, with the earliest resume date.

post.summary: Pause, optionally until a day (`resume_on`, from tomorrow).
End a pause.

get.summary: The plans this agreement may switch to, with price and when it takes effect.

post.summary: Switch to another plan.
The provider's page to put a new payment method on file; the provider sends the buyer back to `return_url` (a path on this site).

get.summary: The user's personal access tokens (never the secret).

post.summary: Create a personal access token. The secret is in this answer and nowhere else.

TeamHeader.name: X-Team-ID
TeamHeader.description: The team this request is about, by id or uuid. A team the user is not in: 403 not_member.

consent_text.description: Shown next to the checkbox. Null: no consent text, the checkbox confirms the order only.

consent_version.description: Send back as consent_version with POST checkout.

button_label.description: The label of the order button (§ 312j Abs. 3 BGB).

url.description: Only in the answer to the invitation itself.

reverses.description: For a credit note: the number of the invoice it reverses.

download_path.description: GET billing/documents/{document}, with the session or token.

amount.description: Formatted as statamic-payments shows it (79,00 EUR).

paid_at.description: ISO 8601 in the display time zone of statamic-payments.

amount_cent.description: The next charge, a running coupon included.

ends_at.description: When the contract ends or ended, once nothing is charged any more: the end of the paid term, not the day it was cancelled. Null while it runs.

ended_label.description: „Gekündigt, läuft bis …" while the paid term runs, „Beendet am <end of term>" after it.

method_note.description: Show under the payment-method button: the verification charge.

cancellation_url.description: § 312k BGB: cancelling without login ("Verträge hier kündigen").

mail_sent.description: Null when nothing was sent because the agreement had already ended.

copied_to.description: Further addresses a copy of the confirmation went to (a team's billing address).
